sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 Represented By Adv. -
 Coram:

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is the successive journey of the Petitioner, who is apprehending his arrest in G.R. Case No.
88 of 2021, arising out of Chandiposh P.S. Case No. 10 of 2021, pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M. at Bonai, Sundargarh, running for the alleged commission of offence under section 379/420/408/294/506/411/34 of the IPC in filing this application under section 438, Cr.P.C., for his release on bail in the event of his arrest.

3. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
4.

Considering the submissions made and on going through the materials available on record; while being not inclined to reconsider the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail to the Petitioner, this application stands disposed of with the observation that in the event, the Petitioner surrenders before the Court in seisin of the aforesaid case within two (02) weeks hence and moves for his release on bail
, the observations made in the earlier order dated 04.07.2022 passed by this Court in ABLAPL No.3703 of 2021 shall spring into action in holding the field.
5. 5. The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
